dependency.owner: Root explicitly owns the Cargo.toml and existing Cargo.lock dependency-edge change.
dependency.excluded: This packet changes no Cargo manifest, lock file, package version, tool/environment or checker configuration.

ownership_design: Each admission synchronously moves its one actual JoinHandle into one lazy Shared<BoxFuture<'static, ()>> before registering the containing Job. No waiter owns the only join future and no new production task is spawned.

The registry retains the Job; the Job retains the Shared completion and the actual result cell. Waiters await only Shared clones. Cancelling or never polling a waiter cannot remove the registry's clone or detach the original task.

The completion awaits the real handle once. With no later await, it writes the original result and true joined state into its separate Arc<Mutex<State>>. The Shared output is only (), not T, E, FinalUseAuthority, AgentdError, or fabricated success.

Non-Clone business values/errors remain in Option<Result<T,E>> or Option<Result<FinalUseAuthority,AgentdError>> and are consumed once by take. No new Clone/Sync bound is placed on T/E and no error string conversion replaces the raw Learning JoinError.

All state mutex guards are synchronous short guards acquired after completion, except Bootstrap's original one-shot receive claim before completion; that claim is explicitly scoped and dropped before await.

The Shared closure captures only the cell plus existing Gate/failure records, never the Job or registry. There is no Job→completion→Job cycle. At actual completion its captured cell clone is released.

Result consumption remains a single cell arbitration among receive/cleanup paths. No first-waiter scheduling guarantee is asserted. The actual normal-retirement caller must continue to establish its existing quiescence and delivered-output conditions before normal Work join.

learning.signatures: All existing receive/retirement/custody public and crate-visible signatures and OriginalJobReceiveError variants remain unchanged.
learning.typed_result: Actual tokio JoinError is stored once and taken by receive_with_join_cause unchanged; legacy receive still maps actual join failure to CommitUncertain through its original wrapper.
learning.failure_priority: receive_with_join_cause still prioritizes the stored real JoinError, then unavailable/failed state, then original output, then actual Gate error. Original E values remain returned inside Ok(Err(E)) with fail-close as before.
learning.pending: The original joined flag is written only after real handle completion. Last Job Drop still refuses to advertise join if supervision is lost; after a real join it removes/drops the actual undelivered output before decrementing pending and notifying waiters.
learning.normal: Normal retirement still rejects any failed join or undelivered output and keeps the original Gate/deadline/quiescence tests. Pending count alone still cannot construct normal completion.
learning.poison: New synchronous cell poison is recovered only to preserve custody and original result; it closes Gate and makes join failure sticky. It never clears an actual JoinError or invents Ok.

bootstrap.receiving: The existing receiving=true claim remains one-shot and is made before awaiting the retained completion. A cancelled receiver does not re-arm it.
bootstrap.real_join_error: The old AgentdError::Protocol(format!(original Root production inputs: {error})) mapping is retained exactly; actual business AgentdError is stored unchanged.
bootstrap.cleanup: close/admission order and fail-first save_original_failure are retained. For each actual completed job, original output is taken after join; undelivered FinalUseAuthority is dropped and original AgentdError remains observable. New terminal-cell poison/missing-join refusal is appended without overriding an already saved original failure.
bootstrap.normal_return: Original output? still precedes Gate.require_open and closing.disarm; no authority is delivered after a closed Gate.
bootstrap.no_missing_handle_shortcut: The previous Option<JoinHandle> slot is replaced by ownership in the retained completion itself; no bare local take-and-await or handle-less success branch exists.
